source_supported_proposition_en: Interrupted Nifas is treated like interrupted Haid: bleeding days are aggregated toward sixty while sub-fifteen-day purity intervals do not create a wholly separate state; after a full fifteen-day purity, later qualifying blood is a new Haid.
